import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

# Data
steps = [0, 100, 500, 1000]
pr    = [0.12, 0.32, 0.93, 0.96]
isr   = [0.064, 0.6423, 0.1324, 0.0028]

# Colors (colorblind-friendly)
C_PR  = '#0072B2'
C_ISR = '#D55E00'

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

# Remove top spine
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

# Left Y-axis: Prove Rate
ax1.set_xlabel('Training Steps', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Prove Rate', color=C_PR, fontsize=12)
ln1 = ax1.plot(steps, pr, color=C_PR, marker='o', markersize=8, linewidth=2,
               label='Prove Rate (left)', zorder=5)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=C_PR, labelsize=10)
ax1.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.05)
ax1.set_xticks(steps)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['0', '100', '500', '1000'], fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)

# Right Y-axis: ISR
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.set_ylabel('ISR* (proved-only)', color=C_ISR, fontsize=12)
ln2 = ax2.plot(steps, isr, color=C_ISR, marker='s', markersize=8, linewidth=2,
               label='ISR* (right)', zorder=5)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=C_ISR, labelsize=10)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.02, 0.75)

# Reference line at ISR=0
ax2.axhline(y=0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)

# Component count annotations
ax2.annotate('~6 comp.', xy=(500, 0.1324), xytext=(540, 0.30),
             fontsize=9, color='#555555',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.0),
             zorder=6)
ax2.annotate('18.6 comp.', xy=(1000, 0.0028), xytext=(820, 0.18),
             fontsize=9, color='#555555',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.0),
             zorder=6)

# Key annotation: ISR=0 for 94.8% at step 1000
ax2.annotate('ISR=0 for 94.8%\nof samples',
             xy=(1000, 0.0028), xytext=(680, -0.06),
             fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic', color=C_ISR,
             ha='center',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF3E0', edgecolor=C_ISR, alpha=0.9),
             zorder=6)

# 99.5% decline annotation (arrow from step 100 to step 1000)
ax2.annotate('',
             xy=(950, 0.02), xycoords='data',
             xytext=(150, 0.62), textcoords='data',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.2,
                             connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'))
ax2.text(520, 0.48, '99.5% ISR decline', fontsize=9, color='#666666',
         rotation=-38, ha='center', va='center',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#cccccc', alpha=0.9))

# Combined legend
lns = ln1 + ln2
labs = [l.get_label() for l in lns]
ax1.legend(lns, labs, loc='center left', fontsize=10, framealpha=0.9,
           edgecolor='#cccccc')

fig.tight_layout()

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_3/projects/solver-trace-ablation/paper/figures/fig2_isr_collapse.pdf'
fig.savefig(out, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', format='pdf')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {out}')
